summary: Mapped Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-1.7B baselines on 2x P150a through SGLang/tt_transformers_paged, plus a single-chip (1,1) probe to test if TP=2 cross-chip comm is the bottleneck. Qwen3-1.7B baseline = 45.9 tok/s, much closer to the 50+ tok/s target; Qwen3-8B is hard-bounded by tt-metal's own 33.6 tok/s ceiling on Llama-3.1-8B P150 single-chip ref, with SGLang overhead bringing us to 27 tok/s. Single-chip layout for Qwen3-8B = same 27 tok/s; TP=2 cross-chip overhead is NOT the bottleneck on this size model.

results.note: TP=2 cross-chip overhead is NOT the bottleneck. Single chip same speed, slightly worse TTFT (more cold-start).
1.6x TPOT speedup vs 8B; 2x TTFT improvement. Within striking distance of the 50+ tok/s target.

tt_metal_reference_perf.interpretation: tt-metal PERF.md does not list Qwen3-1.7B specifically. Llama-3.2-3B on dual-Wormhole N300 (68 t/s) is the closest comparable; our 45.9 t/s for Qwen3-1.7B on dual-Blackhole P300 is somewhat lower, partly because P150's per-chip throughput on similar models (Llama-3.1-8B P150=33.6) is lower than the analogous Wormhole + TP setup.

verdict_goal_1.qwen3_8b_status: 27.4 tok/s; SGLang ceiling near tt-metal ref 33.6 minus ~6ms SGLang overhead per token. Will require SGLang-side per-token cost reduction OR tt-metal kernel speedup to beat tt-metal's own ref.
verdict_goal_1.qwen3_1p7b_status: 45.9 tok/s; close to 50 tok/s. Achievable via per-token SGLang overhead reduction OR larger context buckets / different mem-fraction.

next_steps: For goal 1 with Qwen3-1.7B: profile SGLang per-token overhead, try --max-running-requests > 1 to amortize scheduling cost, or test --enable-prefix-cache for repeated prefills.

For goal 2 (spec > no-spec): EAGLE-3 path A (single prefill_forward) needed; current spec is 8 tok/s vs 27.4 baseline for 8B. Qwen3-1.7B has no published EAGLE-3 draft on HF (Tengyunw/qwen3_8b_eagle3 is 8B-specific).
Try EnablePersistentKernelCache + warm cache (memory tenstorrent-perf-knobs documents 40x cold-start win; may also help post-warmup decode).
